categories.main_business_segments: Telink Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of low-power wireless IoT chips. Its main product lines include IoT chips and audio chips supporting multiple wireless communication protocols such as Bluetooth Low Energy, dual-mode Bluetooth, Zigbee, Matter, and WiFi. The company also develops chips for private 2.4G protocols and wireless audio applications, serving diverse markets including smart retail, consumer electronics, smart lighting, smart home, healthcare, logistics, and audio entertainment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chip design technologies including multi-protocol wireless communication stacks, low-power system-on-chip (SoC) architectures, and RISC-V open instruction set MCUs. It integrates multi-mode RF transceivers supporting Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, and proprietary protocols, with innovations in ultra-low power consumption, high integration, and edge AI capabilities. Manufacturing is outsourced via a fabless model to leading foundries like TSMC and SMIC, with packaging and testing also outsourced to specialized providers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Telink serves leading global brands across multiple sectors including IoT ecosystems (Amazon, Google, Xiaomi), computer peripherals (Logitech, Lenovo), consumer electronics (Skyworth, Changhong, Haier), audio products (JBL, Sony), and smart home brands (Tuya, Yunji). Its chips are widely used in smart retail, smart lighting, smart home, healthcare monitoring, wearable devices, gaming peripherals, and automotive digital key applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas markets including the United States, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region. It has established R&D and sales offices in the US, Egypt, and Hong Kong, supporting global customers and expanding international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Telink operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and service providers. It maintains strong partnerships with leading global suppliers such as SMIC and TSMC, ensuring supply chain stability and flexibility.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in low-power wireless IoT chip technology, multi-protocol integration, and edge AI capabilities. It invests heavily in R&D (over 26% of revenue), advancing chip process nodes (22nm, 40nm, 55nm), and developing new wireless standards including Bluetooth 6.0, Zigbee R23, and SparkLink. Strategic R&D initiatives include ultra-low power multi-mode chips, AIoT platforms, high-precision positioning, automotive digital keys, and multi-core heterogeneous SoCs with integrated AI accelerators.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor chips and licensing of intellectual property. The company sells its products directly and through distributors to OEMs and brand customers. It also earns income from technology services and royalties related to IP licensing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Telink is positioned as a leading player in the global low-power wireless IoT chip market, ranking among the top tier alongside Qualcomm and MediaTek. It holds a dominant position in domestic Zigbee chip shipments and is a key contributor to Bluetooth SIG standards. The company competes strongly in multi-protocol SoCs and wireless audio chips, with a growing presence in emerging AIoT and automotive digital key markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Telink achieved revenue of approximately RMB 844 million, a 32.69% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders nearly doubling to RMB 97.4 million. The company maintains a strong gross margin of 48.34%, improved by 4.84 percentage points. R&D expenses accounted for over 26% of revenue, reflecting aggressive investment in innovation. The company has a registered capital of RMB 240 million and a workforce of 373 employees, showing steady growth and expanding operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Telink differentiates itself through its comprehensive multi-protocol wireless chip portfolio with industry-leading low power consumption and high integration. Its chips support advanced features like Bluetooth 6.0 high-precision positioning, ultra-low latency audio, and integrated edge AI capabilities, enabling innovative AIoT applications. The company offers turnkey solutions combining hardware, protocol stacks, and software development kits, facilitating rapid customer product development and deployment. Strong IP protection, global standard participation, and close collaboration with top-tier customers further enhance its competitive edge.
